summary: Frontend-only regression covering 4 features on marketplace B2B (KDMARCHE x O'SCOP). Verified footer link, LOLODRIVE nav item, /detaillant concept page + language switch to ES, detaillant sales table with real data, and non-regression of espace-detaillant KPIs & offers.

issues: Individual KPI cells (Lots en salle, Mises, Remportes, Montant gagne) are rendered correctly but do NOT expose per-KPI data-testid (e.g. dt-sales-kpi-lots). Only the container dt-sales-table has a testid. Non-blocking, but the review request explicitly mentions '4 KPIs' so adding testids would help future automated verification.

LolodriveLayout.lolo-member-nav is only rendered inside pages that wrap with LolodriveLayout; /lolodrive landing and /coopact do not use it - documented for main agent awareness.
